run_extract_bert_embeddings: run the script to extract BERT embeddings from an IMDB file and save them as numpy arrays
run_bert_embedding_extraction_with_shard: run the script with group_id and n_groups to shard BERT embedding extraction across multiple workers
create_bert_feat_extractor: create a BertFeatExtractor instance that loads a pretrained BERT model and tokenizer for extracting embeddings
get_bert_embedding_for_text: get the BERT embedding vector for a given text string using the BertFeatExtractor class
review_bert_embedding_pipeline: review the extract_bert function that loads an IMDB, extracts BERT embeddings, and saves them individually
